URL: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/21/explosions-in-iran-as-us-launches-new-strikes
(Full article via WebFetch — Al Jazeera newsroom)
CENTCOM completed its 11th consecutive night of strikes, targeting "Iranian military operations centres, maritime capabilities, aircraft hangars, drone storage facilities, and military logistics infrastructure." Explosions reported across Iran: Tabriz (northwest, strike on military zone ~2:40am local), Sirik (south), Bushehr (south), Khuzestan (Behbahan and Omidiyeh).
Iran's military stated: "In response to the repeated aggression of the evil enemy against parts of our country, the Islamic Republic of Iran's army ... targeted the 'ammunition depots'" in Kuwait, Jordan, and Bahrain.
Jordan: Iran targeted Azraq base with drones; Jordan's military intercepted four Iranian missiles; two fell in uninhabited areas.
Bahrain: air-defence sirens sounded; Sheikh Isa airbase targeted.
Strait of Hormuz: CENTCOM claimed the waterway "remains open for commercial vessel transit," saying US forces have "helped facilitate the transit of approximately 900 commercial vessels and 450 million barrels of crude oil" since early May.
Casualties: US military confirmed a third service member dead from Friday's Jordan attack, bringing total US deaths to 18 since the war began.
